props.name: ADR-011
props.summary: Pricing cache TTL must stay at 300s or higher because of the vendor rate limit.
props.text:
ADR-011: Pricing cache TTL must stay at 300s or higher.
Status: accepted. Date: 2026-02-10. Author: Marco Bianchi.
Context: The pricing service caches computed prices. The vendor tax/price API enforces a rate limit. In early February a low TTL during a promo test nearly exhausted that limit (a near-miss).
Decision: The pricing cache TTL (cache_ttl_seconds in pricing/config.yaml) must stay at 300 seconds or higher. Any change below 300s needs a new ADR that supersedes this one.
Consequences: Promo price changes can take up to 5 minutes to show. Faster updates should use cache invalidation, not a lower TTL.
This ADR supersedes the wiki page 'Pricing cache' which said a 60s TTL is fine.
props.title: ADR-011: Pricing cache TTL must stay at 300s or higher

props.text:
